tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text: Copper is purified by electrolytic refining of blister copper. The correct statement(s) about this process is (are)

options.text: Impure Cu strip is used as cathode

Acidified aqueous  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is used as electrolyte

solution.text: Impure Cu is used as anode pure Cu deposited at cathode. Electrolyte is acidified solution of  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math>  impurities settle as anode mud.
